title: geum rivale subsp. subalpinum
intro: Geum rivale subsp. subalpinum, commonly known as alpine avens, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the rose family, characterized by its pink or white flowers and hairy leaves. This plant is used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and inflammation, due to its potential health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Geum rivale subsp. subalpinum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, which may contribute to its healing properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are currently being studied for their potential health benefits.
